services.desc: Comedic greats like Ellen DeGeneres, Dave Chappelle, Robin Williams, Dana Carvey, Wanda Sykes, Drew Carey and Chris Rock got their start at this legendary comedy club. Located in the heart of San Francisco, the Punch Line may be small on space, but really packs a comedic punch -whether you’re looking to liven up a corporate event or business meeting or host a private show with access to the world’s greatest comedians.
